```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 17_correlation_calculate_r
title: If $SP = -30$, $SS_X = 3$, and $SS_Y = 400$, what is Pearson's $r$?
questions:
  - id: calculate_r
    type: numeric
    answer: -0.87
    tolerance: 0.02
    explanation: >
      $r = \dfrac{SP}{\sqrt{SS_X SS_Y}} = \dfrac{-30}{\sqrt{3 \times 400}} = \dfrac{-30}{34.64} = -.87$.
      The sum of products is the same as in our coffee data, but there's less
      variability in $Y$ for it to be compared with, so the correlation is
      stronger.
```
